att2.assist.conscience.1: The Conscience can provide a large amount of game information and basic game settings, as well as some convenient shortcut functions.
att2.assist.conscience.2: The <Player Info> page of the Conscience allows you to view the character name, title, player level, maximum Dahal, maximum health, temperature value and other information.
att2.assist.conscience.3: The <Player Attributes> page of the Conscience allows you to view current attribute values or perform attribute point allocation.
att2.assist.conscience.4: The <Currency Info> page of the Conscience allows you to view the current amount of Chronotons, Sovereign Chaos Scales and Rune Powder, and you can discard Chronotons to share with other players.
att2.assist.conscience.5: The <Map Settings> page of the Conscience allows you to adjust various basic game settings, including <Game Difficulty>, <Monster Health Bars>, <Player Attributes>, <Game Language> and other settings.
att2.assist.conscience.6: The <Other Info> page of the Conscience allows you to view various game records you have made on the map.
att2.assist.conscience.7: The <Main/Side Quests> shortcut of the Conscience allows you to view current main quest progress and obtain certain hints and guidance.
att2.assist.conscience.8: The <Daily Quests> shortcut of the Conscience allows you to view accepted <Daily Quests> and their progress.
att2.assist.conscience.9: The <Gather Items> shortcut of the Conscience can gather nearby dropped items and experience orbs together, and the maximum number of uses will increase as Time/Space Gems are obtained (2-minute cooldown).
att2.assist.conscience.10: The <Horse Whistle> shortcut of the Conscience can quickly summon/retrieve your mount.
att2.assist.conscience.11: The <Quick Repair> shortcut of the Conscience can display the durability percentage of current equipment and allow quick repair using repair tools.
att2.assist.conscience.12: The <Respawn Point> shortcut of the Conscience can return you to your last recorded respawn location for 100 Chronotons.
att2.assist.conscience.13: The <Quick Equipment Swap> shortcut of the Conscience can quickly replace the armor you are wearing.
att2.assist.conscience.14: The <Game Guide> page of the Conscience can display the locations of nearby NPCs and teleport gates.
att2.assist.conscience.15: Holding the Conscience and pressing the <Sneak Key> can summon the <Stock>. You can unlock higher tiers of the <Stock> by obtaining Time Gems, Runes, visiting the Black Market, or consulting the Dahal Master.
att2.assist.shop.16: <Chronotons> is the main currency of this world, and players can buy various items from merchants in various towns.
att2.assist.shop.17: <Sovereign Chaos Scales> is a rare special currency. Players can buy <Sovereign> equipment, <Recycle Spells> and <Small Pockets> from black market merchants in Ryliath and Eolorion, and also exchange materials or perform enchantments in the <Rune Chamber> or <Enchantment Chamber>.
att2.assist.shop.18: At the <Recycle Merchant>, you can sell unwanted items. The higher the item quality, the higher the selling price and the more accumulated recycling experience.
att2.assist.shop.19: <Blacksmiths> and <Potion Merchants> sell most items in the game <randomly>. The higher the item quality, the lower the appearance probability. Players can refresh the shop using the <Force Refresh> sign below the merchant; the natural refresh time is <30 minutes>.
att2.assist.shop.20: At Charles' Casino in the Soquai Forest, players can spend a certain amount of Chronotons to place bets or unlock treasure grids to obtain rich rewards.
att2.assist.shop.21: Fishermen in each city sell some <Fishing Gear>. You can <Fish> in various parts of the Sylberland Continent to obtain additional loot.
att2.assist.shop.22: The NPC Estelle near the gate of Ryliath sells miscellaneous items such as <Small Chairs>, <Sylberland Maps>, <Torches> and so on.
att2.assist.shop.23: Cities on the Sylberland Continent have NPCs that sell mounts such as <Horses>, <Mules>, <Boars>, <Camels> and so on.
att2.assist.shop.24: Repairing equipment or buying weapons and armor at the <Blacksmith> will increase <Blacksmith Level>. The higher the Blacksmith Level, the more durability restored to items and the more items sold by the blacksmith.
att2.assist.shop.25: Chronotons come in six types with different denominations: <Small Coin>: 1, <Big Coin>: 5, <Diamond>: 50, <Amethyst>: 500, <Ruby>: 1000.
att2.assist.shop.26: The <7777 Bet> in Charles' Casino has a chance to obtain items from the <Angband>, <Billgart> and <Ouranos> dimensions.
att2.assist.travel.27: <Waypoint> allow you to move quickly between two locations, but you must unlock them first to use them.
att2.assist.travel.28: The <Sylberland Map> records waypoints across the Sylberland Continent, but you need to <progress the main quest> and <accept sub quests> to unlock more regions and waypoints. Click a waypoint on the map with a mount to <automatically travel to the destination>.
att2.assist.difficult.29: Upon <Death>, players return to their last recorded respawn point and lose some <Chronotons>, <Experience> and <Saturation>. The higher the <Difficulty>, the more severe the penalty.
att2.assist.difficult.30: There are four game difficulties: <Apprentice>, <Veteran>, <Master>, <Nightmare>. The higher the difficulty, the higher the attack, health and movement speed of monsters, and the experience and rewards obtained from killing monsters will also be increased to a certain extent.
att2.assist.difficult.31: On <Nightmare> difficulty, players lose half their Chronotons, all saturation and a large amount of experience upon each death. Monster spawn rate, health, movement speed, resistance and attack power are also greatly increased.
att2.assist.difficult.32: Monsters are divided into <Normal Monster>, <Normal Elite>, <Mutated Elite>, <Super Elite>, <Ultimate Elite>. Super Elites and Ultimate Elites have additional boosts to size, movement speed, attack power and damage reduction, and defeating special elite monsters grants extra rewards.
att2.assist.difficult.33: The color of a monster's health bar represents its level.For normal monsters: Green, Dark Green, Yellow, Dark Yellow, Red, Dark Red.For elites: Normal Elite -> Blue, Super Elite -> Dark Blue, Ultimate Elite -> Dark Cyan.
att2.assist.difficult.34: Monsters in the <Billgart> dimension have stronger resistance to projectiles.Monsters in the <Ouranos> dimension have stronger resistance to fire damage.
att2.assist.difficult.35:
<Normal Elites> have a certain chance to undergo <Ability Mutation>, possessing unique special abilities:
<Attribute Mutation>:<Strength Type>: Very high attack power but relatively low health.<Speed Type>: Very fast movement speed but very low attack power.<Health Type>: Very high health but very slow movement speed.
<Death Mutation>:<Curse Type>: Inflicts negative mental effects on nearby players upon death.<Heal Type>: Restores 50% maximum health to nearby monsters upon death.<Fortify Type>: Grants 5 seconds of invulnerability to nearby monsters upon death.
<Immunity Mutation>:<Attack Immunity>: Gains invulnerability when players are within 5 blocks.<Arrow Immunity>: Destroys player-fired arrows within 5 blocks.<Magic Immunity>: Immune to all damaging Dahal spells.
att2.assist.item.36: Nearly 1000 items of different qualities can be obtained from monster drops, chests, merchants, main quests and sub quests: <Quest Item>, <Common>, <Uncommon>, <Rare>, <Sovereign>, <Epic>, <Legendary>, <Ultimate>, <Mythic>.
att2.assist.item.37: There are six types of weapons with different attack speeds and base damage: <Dagger>, <Sword>, <Axe>, <Spear>, <Hammer>, <Scythe>.
att2.assist.item.38: There are six different weapon qualities, each with unique special attributes and durability values: <Wood>, <Stone>, <Iron>, <Copper>, <Gold>, <Diamond>, <Netherite>.
att2.assist.item.39: Gold equipment obtained in the Angband dimension restores a small amount of durability at regular intervals.
att2.assist.item.40: After drinking a potion, the player gains temporary attribute bonuses, but their duration does not stack. Each drink overwrites the same attribute effect while retaining different ones.
att2.assist.item.41: There are 15 sets of Epic and Legendary quality gear sets, which can be distinguished by the <Set Bonus> text below them. Equipping a full set grants additional attribute bonuses.
att2.assist.item.42: After breaking the arena gate outside Asunark Island, you can buy <Otaurian Armor> from the NPC <Homer> around the island, which allows you to move more durably and quickly underwater.
att2.assist.item.43: <Daggers> have faster attack speed, lower attack power and shorter attack range, with very high critical strike effectiveness.
att2.assist.item.44: <Swords> have more balanced attack speed and attack power, with more balanced critical strike effectiveness.
att2.assist.item.45: <Axes> have lower attack speed and higher attack power, with low critical strike effectiveness. Holding an axe, press <F (Swap Item Key)> to throw it and damage enemies.
att2.assist.item.46: <Spears> have very low attack speed and high attack power, with low critical strike effectiveness. When attacking with a spear, pay attention to the distance from enemies. Maintaining a proper distance deals higher damage, otherwise lower damage.
att2.assist.item.47: <Hammers> have extremely low attack speed and very high attack power, with very low critical strike effectiveness. Jump attacking with a <Hammer> can knock enemies back slightly, while also recoiling the user.
att2.assist.item.48: <Scythes> have lower attack speed and higher attack power, with low critical strike effectiveness. Holding a scythe reveals enemy weak points. Striking weak points deals massive damage, otherwise lower damage.
att2.assist.item.49: When <Shield> is right-clicked to block, holding a weapon and pressing Sneak puts the shield on cooldown and releases various melee skills.
att2.assist.item.50: Attacking with different weapons accumulates a certain amount of Fatigue. The higher the Fatigue, the more attack speed is reduced. Therefore, pay attention to attack rhythm during combat and avoid swinging wildly.
att2.assist.item.51: Bow and crossbow damage is related to your current <Strength> attribute and <Power Enchantment Level>.
att2.assist.item.52: There are several types of <Rune Arrows> that can be crafted from arrows in the Rune Chamber of Ryliath.
att2.assist.attribute.53: Nine <Attributes> affect player stats: <Strength>, <Critical>, <Resistance>, <Attack Speed>, <Movement Speed>, <Luck>, <Hunger Resistance>, <Health Regeneration>, <Dahal Regeneration>.
att2.assist.attribute.54: <Strength> increases or reduces melee or ranged weapon damage. For melee weapons, Strength provides a percentage boost to base attack damage.
att2.assist.attribute.55: <Critical> increases critical strike chance and damage for melee, ranged and spell attacks. Different weapons/spells have different critical strike effectiveness.
att2.assist.attribute.56: <Resistance>: Each point grants 5% damage reduction and 3 flat damage reduction.
att2.assist.attribute.57: <Attack Speed>: Each point increases or reduces attack speed by 10%.
att2.assist.attribute.58: <Movement Speed>: Each point increases or reduces movement speed by 10%.
att2.assist.attribute.59: <Luck> increases or reduces rewards from monsters, chests, fishing and bosses.
att2.assist.attribute.60: <Hunger Resistance> increases the strength of saturation effects and shortens their cycle. Low values cause hunger effects.
att2.assist.attribute.61: <Health Regeneration>: Each point increases or reduces health recovery by 0.05 per second. Negative values cause health loss.
att2.assist.attribute.62: <Dahal Regeneration> increases Dahal recovery per second.
att2.assist.attribute.63: Wearing equipment, allocating attributes, casting spells, drinking potions and special enchantments all increase or reduce your attributes.
att2.assist.attribute.64: Each Time Gem placed grants 5 <Ability Points>.
att2.assist.attribute.65: You can reset your <Ability Points> at the <Ability Master> in Ryliath. The higher your level, the more Chronotons required to reset (maximum 500 Chronotons).
att2.assist.reputation.66: There are more than 150 NPCs in various dimensions and regions.
att2.assist.reputation.67: Right-click NPCs to talk to them. Some NPCs with a <!> above their heads may need your help.
att2.assist.reputation.68: Talking to all NPCs in a region increases player Reputation Points.
att2.assist.reputation.69: <Reputation Points> affect your current <Title> to a certain extent.
att2.assist.reputation.70: <Reputation Points> affect shop discounts, increase the probability of high-quality items appearing, and also affect the refresh and acceptance of <Daily Quests>.
att2.assist.quest.71: As the <Main Quest> progresses and <Reputation Points> increase, some NPCs will offer new quests.
att2.assist.quest.72: Some side quests require you to provide special items, usually by standing on a <Golden Pressure Plate> to deliver them.
att2.assist.quest.73: The side quest <Ultimate Challenge> unlocks after completing 59 side quests. Completing its <Parkour> and <Arena> challenges grants massive rewards.
att2.assist.quest.74: There are three types of keys: <Small Key>, <Big Key>, <Emerald Key>, obtained during main and sub quests. Hold the key and right-click locks to open certain locked doors.
att2.assist.exploit.75: As main and side quests progress, players can unlock regions and waypoints on the <Sylberland Map>.
att2.assist.exploit.76: The <Sylberland Map> must be used on the main continent. Select the corresponding <Waypoint> to automatically travel to the destination with a mount.
att2.assist.exploit.77: In various dimensions and regions, there are many <Symbol>, <CheckPoint>, <Panorama> and <Secrets> waiting to be discovered.
att2.assist.exploit.78: There are more than 2000 <Achievements> waiting to be completed. Completing <Achievements> rewards <Exploration Points>. Current maximum obtainable <Exploration Points>: %s/%s.
att2.assist.exploit.79: Completing achievements grants <Exploration Points> and <Experience>. Every 150 <Exploration Points> can be exchanged for massive rewards at the Exploration Point Warehouse behind NPC <Writh_Razgork> in Ryliath.
att2.assist.exploit.80: There are more than 1300 <Symbol> scattered across dimensions; triggering them grants Chronotons and experience.
att2.assist.exploit.81: There are more than 90 <Hidden Shulker Boxes> scattered across dimensions, disguised as various blocks with richer loot, usually along the main paths of <Main Quests> and <Sub Quests>.
att2.assist.exploit.82: There are many <Cracked Walls> across dimensions. Players must unlock the <Earthquake Synergy> ability during the main quest in the <Billgart Dimension> to use the <Earthquake> spell to shatter them.
att2.assist.exploit.83: There are many <Frozen Treasures> scattered across the Sylberland Continent. Players must unlock <Fire Synergy> in the <Vonaheim Dungeon> to use <Fire Spells> to melt the ice.
att2.assist.exploit.84: You can obtain an <Exploration Log> from NPC <Wirth_Razgork> in Ryliath, which records your various exploration progress data.
att2.assist.exploit.85: In the temple of the village of Kortaek, there is a mysterious teleport location leading through winding mazes filled with many monsters, trial chests and rune chests. An item called <Ghostfire Glimmer> can be obtained from various maze events and used to mark the maze path.
att2.assist.exploit.86: There are more than 400 <Check Point> scattered across dimensions. Activating all respawn points in each area unlocks an achievement.
att2.assist.exploit.87: Some <Hidden Achievements> are extremely difficult to complete, but they generally do not increase <Exploration Points>.
att2.assist.exploit.88: There are four mansions on the Sylberland Continent waiting to be unlocked, usually requiring certain main quest progress or sub quest completion.
att2.assist.exploit.89: After unlocking a house, you can spend Chronotons for <House Expansion>, which unlocks a large number of <Storage Chests>, <Cake>, and allows teleportation between houses via the <Teleport Room> inside.
